US clocks fall back: Wall Street opens an hour later for traders in Asia and Europe
US clocks fall back: Wall Street opens an hour later for traders in Asia and Europe
items.summary: The change doesn’t alter exchange hours, but it does shift when global liquidity overlaps. Asia-Pacific desks now see US cash trading start and finish an hour later on their clocks, which narrows the gap between the Wall Street close and the Asian open and changes when US-driven moves first reach Asian markets. For Europe, the London and New York overlap returns to its normal winter shape after a week in which the US was an hour closer than usual. The main operational risk is mis-timed orders, alerts and automated strategies set to local clocks, particularly around US data releases and the Sunday futures reopen. --- The exchanges haven’t moved an inch, but for anyone trading New York from Sydney, Tokyo or London, Wall Street just pushed its alarm clock back an hour. Economic and event calendar in Asia Monday, November 2, 2026 - another China PMI
items.summary: China’s private-sector manufacturing PMI is due at 01:45 GMT on Monday (20:45 US Eastern on Sunday), with economists expecting factory activity to keep growing in October, though at a slower pace than in September. The RatingDog China General Manufacturing PMI, compiled by S&P Global, is forecast to ease to 51.6 from 52.1, according to a Reuters poll. That would still leave the index comfortably above the 50 mark that separates expansion from contraction. The latest injury update on New England Patriots wide receiver AJ Brown and the fantasy football impact. This leaves the Patriots with just three wide receivers. DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism, and Kyle Williams will handle the wide receiver snaps on Sunday. It's been a brutal season for Brown and his fantasy football owners. He will now miss Week 8, and there is a chance he misses more time beyond this. Many fantasy football owners had high hopes for Brown this season, but it's getting late quickly, and he has given them next to nothing in an injury-plagued year. All we can do now is monitor him as we get closer to Week 9.

Noah Fifita escaped pressure and delivered a stunning 94-yard touchdown pass as Arizona battled Texas Tech in a key Big 12 matchup. The time to call Noah Fifita one of college football's best kept secrets is over. He's a serious player in the college football landscape. The senior quarterback showed as much in the first half against Texas Tech. In a 3rd-and-12 situation after a sluggish start for the offense (punt, turnover on downs, punt following an opening drive field goal), Fifita escaped the pocket from his own goal line and threw a dot along the sidelines to Isaiah Mizell for a 94-yard touchdown pass.

Paul George scored 38 points at 36 years old, and now he is adding 18 more. The Celtics are winning big, and the data shows his age is a myth. George's veteran poise steered the offense with a fluidity surprising for his age, even as Payton Pritchard scored 30 and Jayson Tatum contributed 26. He entered the season with something to prove after dealing with injuries and a rough stretch over the last two years, according to Yahoo Sports . His early work suggests he is ready for a major bounce-back year that could define the Eastern Conference race. George looked comfortable creating shots for teammates while still showing the scoring punch that made him a star.

The Real Madrid head coach said that causing offence was one of the "dangers of today's world" but added that the France forward acted "very responsibly" and showed "true class" by quickly apologising.

The Atlanta Braves exercised Ozzie Albies' $7 million option for 2027. He hit a career-low .237, yet the team kept him. Here is the surprising math behind the move. Most fans expected the team to walk away from a player who struggled so hard. Albies hit just .194 in the second half of the season with a .575 OPS. Those numbers are ugly for a guy who made four All-Star teams before. Yet the Braves paid the full price to keep him in Atlanta for one more year. His original seven-year, $35 million contract now enters its final year for the 29-year-old switch-hitter.

From a fake fair catch to a blind field goal lateral, these college football trick plays fooled defenses and changed games Coaches spend hours watching film to find tiny mistakes in how a team lines up. A good fake handoff, a surprise pass or a player acting like he isn't part of the play can flip a game upside down in a second. Some of these crazy calls led to famous touchdowns and huge wins. Others blew up completely, but people still talk about them anyway. The best trick plays all do the same thing, they get the defense to chase a ghost. By the time the other team figures out what is going on, the ball is already gone.

CINCINNATI (AP) — Cincinnati Reds closer Emilio Pagán declined a $10 million player option for 2027 on Saturday, deciding to become a free agent.Cincinnati also declined a $16 million mutual option on third baseman/designated hitter Eugenio Suárez and an $8 million mutual option on right-hander Pierce Johnson, who gets a $1 million buyout. Pagán was 5-1 with a 3.38 ERA and 25 saves in 28 chances this year, when he had a $10 million salary . He didn't pitch for the Reds between May 5 and July 3 because of a strained left hamstring . The 35-year-old right-hander has 90 saves in 10 major league seasons, the last three with the Reds.

Cincinnati will now need to find a closer for 2027, assuming they plan on ever having a lead in the 9th inning. Emilio Pagán officially declined his option to return to the club for next season, as BBWAA writer Francys Romero reported earlier in the day. In doing so, he'll hit the market in search of another multi-year pact from someone, though in theory the Reds themselves could still be in the mix for his services on a new deal. Pagán missed nearly two months of the 2026 season after a devastating hamstring strain, though as Romero notes he returned in excellent form through the end of the season.

The British government has never formally apologised for slavery despite repeated calls from a number of Commonwealth leaders. Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he is "open" to the possibility of the UK formally apologising for its role in the transatlantic slave trade, but has ruled out financial reparations. BALTIMORE (AP) — The Baltimore Orioles declined outfielder Luis Robert Jr.'s $20 million club option for 2027. The Orioles claimed Robert off waivers from the New York Mets on Aug. 31, assuming an obligation of roughly $4.9 million from the Mets — the remainder of this year's salary plus a $2 million buyout of the 2027 option. The Chicago White Sox had picked up his $20 million option for 2026 before trading him to the Mets last offseason. Robert played only three games for the Orioles before landing on the injured list because of hamstring issues. He's struggled to regain the form he showed when he was an All-Star in 2023.

BALTIMORE (AP) — Division III Johns Hopkins used an obscure rule to win its game against Muhlenberg on Saturday, prevailing 31-28 when Kaleb Wayt made a 39-yard field goal on a fair catch kick.When a player makes a fair catch, the receiving team has the option of attempting a field goal from that spot on the next play. Every now and then, it's attempted in the NFL, sometimes from unusually long distances, and the rule was added for college before this season. With the score tied at 28, Alex Orecchio made a fair catch on a short punt at the Muhlenberg 29. Then Wayt connected on the 39-yard field goal, putting the Blue Jays ahead with two seconds remaining.

Using a fake DOB or leaving the field blank when making an online account can offer protection from identity theft You get a call from your bank saying there has been suspicious activity on your account. They read out your name, address and date of birth so you are happy it is a legitimate caller. But you are talking to criminals who have used your date of birth as part of a web of verifying information to convince you they are someone else. The “Scottish Labour party” had formally split from Labour at the beginning of 1976, driven by disillusionment over the party’s timid proposals for a new Scottish assembly. Michigan squeaked out a win over Rutgers on Saturday and dropped two spots in ESPN’s SP+ rankings as a result. Here’s where things stand heading into Week 10: For those of you who might be new to SP+, it's an advanced metric that takes into account a team's offensive, defensive, and special teams efficiencies. It combines all three metrics into one uniform metric that predicts how many points a given team would defeat (or lose to) the "average" college football team by on a neutral field. In other words, it's a metric designed to look at how "good" teams really are at different aspects of the game rather than ranking them purely on their resumes.

Eric Morris admitted Oklahoma State had few defensive answers after surrendering 581 yards and 51 points to Iowa State. China Media Group, which acknowledged Mbappé's apology, has not said how long the blackout will last. Assistant coach and Director of Scouting Rick Stockstill will serve as interim head coach for the remainder of this season, according to Florida State President Richard McCullough and reported by Nick Bromberg of Yahoo Sports . "We have made the decision to change the leadership of our football program," McCullough said in a statement. "We thank Mike Norvell for his commitment and service to Florida State and wish him and his family the very best. We understand the deep passion of Seminole fans and share their high expectations for this program. We are confident in Rick Stockstill's ability to…

LOS ANGELES (AP) — Luka Doncic had 45 points, a season-high 15 rebounds, six assists and five steals in another prolific performance while leading the Los Angeles Lakers to a 131-125 victory over the Toronto Raptors on Sunday night.Doncic hit eight 3-pointers and increased his early lead in the NBA scoring race by dropping at least 37 points in his fourth consecutive game. Austin Reaves scored 19 points and Walker Kessler had 16 points and 15 rebounds for the Lakers, who rebounded nicely from a 17-point loss at Golden State on Friday in which they blew a 25-point lead.

Cutter Gauthier’s hat trick and a lethal Anaheim power play sparked a comeback from a 3-0 deficit. After building a commanding 3-0 lead in the first period, the Senators completely fell apart, surrendering six unanswered goals in a 6-3 loss to the Anaheim Ducks. Cutter Gauthier led the Ducks' comeback with a hat trick, while Anaheim's dangerous power play did exactly what the Senators had been warned about heading into the game. The Ducks scored four straight goals with the man advantage, turning what had looked like a comfortable Senators victory into a beatdown.

Referees separate players following a fight during an American Hockey League game between the San Diego Gulls and Colorado Eagles on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at Pechanga Arena in San Diego, California. Wilkes-Barre/Scranton earned a big shutout win over Hershey on Sunday. Despite getting badly outshot, WBS blitzed Hershey 5-0 and is back in the win column. Melvin Fernstrom got things started with a sick highlight-reel goal in the first period. Fernstrom went right through two Hershey players and went forehand-to-backhand for a sick goal. The party was just getting started for the Penguins as Bill Zonnon scored later in the period to make it 2-0. He went to the net and stuffed the puck home, doubling the Penguins' lead. It's his second goal in as many games, and he now has five to start the season.

The Penguins made a roster move Sunday to send one of their young forwards back to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (WBS). The Penguins re-assigned forward Rutger McGroarty to the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (WBS) Penguins, their AHL affiliate. McGroarty, 22, had been kept on the NHL roster as an extra forward for Thursday's game against the Utah Mammoth and for Saturday's road tilt against thhe Montreal Canadiens , although he did not appear in either game. McGroarty suited up for WBS on Sunday, when the Penguins defeated the Hershey Bears, 5-0, registering a goal in the contest.

Martin pursues undefeated season, L.D. Bell attempts first district title since 1988 and Jesuit and Prosper Rock Hill compete for playoff spot. Arlington Martin secured a district championship Friday with a 41-31 win over rival Arlington . The victory put Martin within one win of its first undefeated regular season in program history. Several other Dallas-area teams are also on the brink of perfect seasons. Other undefeated teams entering Week 11 include: Allen, Anna , Frisco Lone Star , Lewisville, Mansfield Timberview and North Crowley .

Hannah Hidalgo got her senior year started on an extremely high note. Hidalgo found herself heavily involved early, scoring the first two baskets for Notre Dame and assisting the next two baskets. A flawless second quarter saw Hidalgo go a perfect 4-for-4 from the field, including two 3-pointers. She took Notre Dame into halftime with 18 points. The Irish led by 19 after the first half. Villanova turned in a strong third quarter, dropping 27 points and keeping Hidalgo in check. Despite that, Notre Dame managed to drop 25, preventing Villanova from getting back into the game.

We’re keeping track of Notre Dame’s opponents and how they do each and every week — because it might be fun. Notre Dame took a minute or two to get going against the Wisconsin Badgers in the season opener, but eventually the Irish whooped them 42-13. Notre Dame welcomed the Rice Owls to South Bend for the home opener, and sent them back to Texas with a 52-0 loss. Although the Irish were big favorites against Michigan State, they got their best shot — and still beat the Spartans 27-10. The Irish were once again massive favorites over a Big 10 team, and they more than covered against Purdue with a 49-10 win that was never that close. Notre Dame was better than a three touchdown favorite…

Denver Broncos running back Jonah Coleman ran 11 times for 41 yards and a score in Week 8, and he added four receptions for 63 yards on five targets Why it Matters: Coleman led the team in both rushing and receiving yards, compiling 104 scrimmage yards. He has emerged as the more explosive option in the backfield, and his fantasy value could continue to increase as his touches likely go up. He remains a solid RB3 or flex fantasy play for now. This article originally appeared on USA TODAY: Jonah Coleman totals 104 scrimmage yards in Week 8

Kansas City Chiefs WR Xavier Worthy bottled up in loss to Broncos Why it Matters: After a couple of decent outings, Worthy has managed just 24 receiving yards on six receptions over the last two games. For a player whose calling card is speed, Worthy hasn't been able to produce many big plays. Throw in the return of Rashee Rice, and Worthy is no more than a WR5. This article originally appeared on USA TODAY: Xavier Worthy has quiet outing in Week 8 loss

Kansas City Chiefs TE Travis Kelce manages 67 yards in Week 8 to the Broncos Why it Matters: Kelce topped 60 receiving yards for the first time since Week 2, and while his production has been a little up and down this season, he has been targeted 20 times over the last three games. Kelce should continue to deliver a handful of catches and around 50 yards each week, putting him in the low-end TE1 mix. Legendary New York Yankees pitcher Goose Gossage ripped Jazz Chisholm Jr. in a recent interview with NJ.com. The post New York Yankees Legend Goose Gossage Doesn’t Hold Back on Jazz Chisholm Jr. appeared first on HEAVY. One thing Chisholm did that caused him to receive plenty of discontent from Yankees fans was suck on a lollipop while playing second base. After the incident, manager Aaron Boone made it clear he wasn't a fan. "It just bothered me, and it was addressed," Boone said. "I don't think that should be a part of what we're doing."

The forward has been special to start the season. In a strong rookie class, Golden State Warriors forward Yaxel Lendeborg is making the case that he is the best of the bunch. The start of Lendeborg's season has been tremendous, sliding right into the Warriors rotation. In fact, Lendeborg is already one of the Warriors' best and most important players next to franchise legend Steph Curry. With Curry out on Sunday against the Los Angeles Clippers , the Warriors needed someone to step up and take control of the offense. Lendeborg was up for the challenge, scoring points at a rate that no Warriors rookie has done since Curry himself.

Washington Capitals draft pick, dealt to the Blues as part of the Jordan Kyrou trade, scored in back-to-back games for first points in SHL; 2026 first-round pick continues to shine at Boston University We mentioned him in last week's prospect report as having gotten off to a slow start with Brynas IF of the Swedish Hockey League, where the second-round pick in the 2025 NHL Draft is playing after the Blues loaned the forward out. He had no points and was getting little ice time through the first nine games of the season, including games in which he was dressed but didn't take a shift in the season-opener, then played 2:48 and 30 seconds total in the following two games.

Another scoring outburst by Luka Doncic allowed the Lakers to push their way past a feisty Raptors squad. After giving up the first five points of the game, the Lakers got themselves going and ended the first quarter with a 36-23 lead. They forced nine turnovers in the first period, and they led the rest of the way. Even after coach JJ Redick started taking his starters out with less than three minutes left in the fourth quarter and Toronto came to within five points with 43.7 seconds left, L.A. was never truly in danger of losing, although Toronto did create a bit of a scare in the final moments.

Jason Williams: The Bengals expected to play championship football. They've fallen way short of that so far. Is it time to question Zac Taylor's job? The front office finally overhauled the defense last offseason. The Bengals pulled out a 43-36 overtime win against the lowly Tennessee Titans before a mostly subdued 66,209 fans at Paycor Stadium on Nov. 1, aided by a couple of key defensive stops down the stretch, including a sack by the biggest offseason acquisition. Quarterback Joe Burrow, guarding his words, made sure to point out in his mixed-emotions presser: "We lost that game the last three years."

Renato Moicano admits he was "frustrated" when Dan Miragliotta stood him from back control at UFC Vegas 123. Ashton Jeanty ceded all but three of his team's 28 carries by running backs in Week 8, but he saved his fantasy day with 64 yards receiving. Why It Matters: Jeanty was bypassed in the run game in favor of rookie Mike Washington Jr. but took a screen pass 45 yards to set up the go-ahead score in the fourth quarter. Entering this game, Jeanty had 328 rush yards on 3.1 yards per attempt, with just one rushing score. In his last three games, he has rushed for 64 yards on 28 carries but has 15 receptions for 147 yards with a TD. Perhaps the Raiders are starting to transition Jeanty into more of the pass game, especially since Washington has been outperforming him in the run game. That said,…

It wasn't always pretty, but the Commanders dominate the Eagles 27-10. The Commanders were awful, then the Eagles showed how bad they are, and the Commanders still won 27-10 at Northwest Stadium on NBC Sunday Night Football. Last year, the Eagles were up big late, scored, and went for two to rub it in. Apparently Dan Quinn didn't forget this: when Rachaad White scored with 1:52 remaining, Quinn called for the two-point attempt, and Austin Ekeler scored on a run up the middle to add salt to the Eagles' wounds. The Commanders started horribly, as quarterback Jayden Daniels missed some open receivers; his timing looked off; there were two dropped passes; and yes, more pre-snap penalties. All…

Xavier has won 36 consecutive season-openers as Mount St. Mary's visits Cintas Center to begin the 2026-27 campaign. But hope springs eternal with the start of a new season. In the NIL and transfer portal world, roster overhauls can be swift. Xavier, like many other teams across the country, reloaded in a hurry and now have NCAA Tournament aspirations just seven-plus months removed from having the program's fewest wins (15) in a full season in 30 years. After a busy offseason and a 3-0 record in October exhibitions , Xavier opens the second year of the Richard Pitino era with high expectations on Monday, Nov. 2 when Mount St. Mary's visits Cintas Center.

Mitch Albom: The Detroit Lions were, quite simply, in a battle with the Vikings, both for the NFC North, and to live up to who they could be. This was a war. It was bound to be, given that Minnesota had swept the Lions in their two meetings last season, the second loss resulting in six embarrassing turnovers and eliminating Detroit from the playoffs – on Christmas Day, no less! Dan Campbell and Co. do not like to get swept or embarrassed. They hate to get eliminated. They had this game circled the day the schedule came out.

Kirk Cousins threw for multiple touchdowns for the seventh time in eight games, passing for three scores and running for another against the Jets. Why It Matters: Cousins continued his incredible comeback season with his fourth game with three TD passes and his seventh multi-TD effort. He also came through in the clutch, throwing a go-ahead 2-yard TD to Jalen Nailor early in the fourth quarter. Since throwing for only 160 yards in the opener against Miami, Cousins has thrown for at least 243 yards in each of the last seven games. The 38-year-old is a strong QB2 option after going undrafted in most leagues, and he is a must-play in two QB leagues as long as the Raiders remain in the playoff…

The Big South's Runnin' Bulldogs went 4-29 last season with two Division 1 wins, both against USC Upstate. A six-game losing streak and an abysmal offense have Philadelphia spiraling toward a top draft pick, echoing the late-season collapse that ended the legendary Andy Reid era. The Philadelphia Eagles entered " Sunday Night Football " looking to snap a five-game losing streak that started in a 27-7 loss to the Chicago Bears on "Monday Night Football" in Week 3. The Eagles started the season 0-2, but have unraveled. Quarterback Jalen Hurts has been out since before Philadelphia lost 25-14 to the Carolina Panthers on Oct. 18, and is not expected to return for the remainder of the season while he deals with a health issue.

The Pittsburgh Steelers ran for 200 yards in Sunday’s 27-6 win over the Cleveland Browns at Acrisure Stadium. The fourth straight victory sends them into their bye at 6-2 and alone atop the AFC North. However, the series that drew scrutiny afterward was one in which Pittsburgh put the ball in the air: a first-half trip to the Cleveland 2-yard line that ended with two incompletions, a run for no gain, and a field goal. Head coach Mike McCarthy voiced regret about the sequence after the game, and the reaction to his candor was divided.

Kansas City and Denver have released their inactive player lists for Sunday's game. Tackle Diego Pounds, cornerback Mansoor Delane, fullback Ben VanSumeren and defensive ends Jack Pyburn and Tyreke Smith will not dress. Rookie Garrett Nussmeir has been designated as the third quarterback and is eligible to enter the game should starter Patrick Mahomes and backup Justin Fields become unavailable. Delane was a midweek downgrade in practice with the shoulder injury that has plagued him all season. He was designated as questionable on Friday's final injury report , but the team later ruled him out on Saturday before departing for Denver.

Would a salary cap help the Cincinnati Reds? Would it compel a trade of Elly De La Cruz? How long will an MLB lockout last? A labor lockout by owners looms with the 11:59 p.m. Dec. 1 expiration of the collective bargaining agreement, and that not only will immediately freeze all MLB business − including free agency a month into the process − but also threatens to delay spring training and maybe even the 2027 regular season. If you don't believe the owners and commissioner Rob Manfred are prepared for a lengthy battle over a long-sought salary cap , you weren't listening when Manfred spoke to reporters during an all-small-market World Series that seemed to belie the owners' parity argument.

The Eagles lost their sixth straight game and fell to last place, prompting angry reactions from fans on X. The Eagles started fast, scoring the game's first 10 points, but then gave up 27 unanswered points for the loss. The loss put the Eagles into last place in the NFC East with a 2-6 record. (AP) — Vincent Janssen had a goal and two assists, David Da Costa added one of each and the Portland Timbers moved into a playoff spot with a 3-1 victory over the Houston Dynamo on Sunday night.Portland (12-14-7) jumped from 11th place in the Western Conference to eighth with one match remaining in the regular season. Houston (14-10-9) still has a chance to finish in the top four and earn the home-field advantage in the best-of-3 first round. Portland jumped in front in the 25th minute when Da Costa took a pass from Janssen and scored his career-high seventh goal in his second full season. Janssen's assist was his first in 13 MLS matches.

The New York Rangers came out of a nearly week-long break with a 4-1 loss to the Edmonton Oilers on Sunday night, dropping their fourth consecutive game. After Igor Shesterkin's season-ending injury on Oct. 9, Garand was forced to start in seven consecutive games and played in nine straight games. While he started off strong, as the fatigue began to set in, the cracks in his game became more evident. Both Garand's individual play and the Rangers' overall team game faltered, indicative of their three straight losses going into their six-day break and the 10 total goals Garand gave up over his two previous starts.

NEW YORK (AP) — Former Cleveland Guardians pitchers Emmanuel Clase and Luis Ortiz go to trial Monday on charges that they accepted bribes as they colluded with gamblers who made hundreds of thousands of dollars betting correctly on individual pitches.Their careers and possibly their freedom are at stake in the jury trial expected to unfold over the next month in Brooklyn federal court. Clase, the Guardians' former closer, and Ortiz, a starter, have pleaded not guilty to conspiracy charges and are on nondisciplinary leave from the club without pay while their fate is determined.
